IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE SPANNING 6 DECADESEach decade features its own visual identity and carefully curated tracklist, letting you jump between musical eras or build the ultimate throwback-to-modern playlist in one seamless experience. Discover it all through the all-new Adventure Mode, a cheerful story-driven journey that has you dancing your way through the decades.DANCE TO SONGS EVERYONE KNOWSCelebrate iconic intergenerational hits brought to life with unique choreography, including fan favorites like:- "NUEVAYoL" by Bad Bunny- "Manchild" by Sabrina Carpenter- "Danza Kuduro" by Lucenzo Ft. Don Omar- "Turn Down for What" by DJ Snake & Lil Jon- "Feel Good Inc." by Gorillaz- "Bye Bye Bye" by *NSYNC- "Wannabe" by Spice Girls- "No Scrubs" by TLC- "It's Tricky" by Run-D.M.C- "Uptown Girl" by Billy Joel- "Mamma Mia" by ABBAAND MORE!From easy-to-follow to satisfyingly challenging, this year's tracklist is made to get players of all ages and styles dancing together!DISCOVER A FUN ADVENTURE FOR ALL GENERATIONSExplore the decades together in the new Adventure Mode. Discover 6 themed worlds, dance to iconic songs, enjoy fun mini-activities, and unlock exclusive rewards. Only available with Just Dance: Decades of Hits!ENDLESS WAYS TO PARTYDance with up to 6 players locally, jump into Party Mode, or get moving with Workout Mode. Grab your friends and family, choose your mode or dance, and let the party begin!Software description provided by the publisher.Bundle includes the following:For details on the products in this bundle, including up-to-date system compatibility information, please refer to each product page listed below.Just Dance Free ExperienceGamesJust Dance: Decades of Hits – 2000s Cosmetic PackGamesRelated tagsMusicPartyMotion controlsOnline scoreboardsPlay for a high scoreCompete onlineCross-platform playMeet up and play togetherPlay together on one consoleShow moreAbout this itemSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeSoftware compatibility and play experience may differ on Nintendo Switch Lite. source.title: The Witch's Bakery
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 8Fantasy Violence, Language, Suggestive ThemesGamesThe Witch's BakeryVersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalFantasy Violence, Language, Suggestive ThemesLoadingThe Witch's Bakery is a cozy Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris!The Witch's Bakery is a cozy Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris. She has one special power: she can see into people's heart and heal emotions through magic!YOUR DAILY LIFE AS A WITCH-BAKER IN PARIS!You play as Lunne, who has just arrived in the city! Each day is split into three phases:- Daytime, where Lunne manages her bakery and serves clients with her team of friends.- Evening, where Lunne explores Paris, builds relationships, discovers the city's secrets and goes inside her friends' troubled heart.- Night, where Lunne rests, improves her magic, decorates her bakery and spends time in her cosy atelier.The story progresses through the days as you earn experience, money, and fame, meet new friends and heal their heart.A COLORFUL PARIS IN A JOYFUL ADVENTURE!Once your work day is done, you can visit several districts of Paris to meet with main characters, engage in activities to learn new skills, buy books for new recipes, etc.From typical streets of famous districts like Montmartre and the Grands Boulevards, to more intimate promenades known only by locals, Paris has many wonders to discover.Each district has its own characters, activities and shops!A STORY ABOUT EMOTIONS AND VULNERABILITYFor some people, their emotion is locked away so strongly than Lunne needs to go inside their heart to help them. She enters their "Heart Palace", a magical space where emotions and thoughts take shape. Lunne needs to guide the personified Emotion back to the heart. Inside the Heart Palace, Lunne discovers the person's deepest struggles and finds the key ingredient she needs to make a bread that will heal them!Software description provided by the publisher.Related tagsAdventureSimulationPuzzle-solving elementsShow moreAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)2 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
